primary_electrical_review.table_77_caution: Drive figures are typical at 25 C, nominal supply and TT process; no guaranteed drive-current inference.
primary_electrical_review.reset: Input tri-state with NO weak pull-up or pull-down while CRESET_N is LOW.
primary_electrical_review.unconfigured: Input tri-state with NO weak pull-up or pull-down while CRESET_N is HIGH and CDONE is LOW.
primary_electrical_review.unused_user_mode: Input tri-state with weak pull-up by default.
primary_electrical_review.page_86_footnotes: 34 affects ordinary GPIO pull-down selection; 35/36 concern CSO/NSTATUS, not M4/M6.
primary_electrical_review.page_14_features: No LVDS-resource GPIO DDIO, Schmitt or pulldown; adjustable drive and slew are unavailable in F256.
primary_electrical_review.page_14_output_budget: Recommended <=16 output/bidirectional LVDS-resource GPIO per bank. This addition uses two.
primary_electrical_review.page_23_separation: At least two unused LVDS pairs between GPIO and native LVDS when mixing. No native LVDS mode used here.

low_default_calculation.engineering_assumption: At most 20 uA aggregate upward leakage, including FPGA plus external receiving gate.
